d: The Sales Manager will be responsible for leading and managing sales operations for animal feed products, developing new business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and achieving sales and revenue targets. The role requires strong knowledge of the animal feed industry, particularly poultry and livestock feed markets.
q: Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within the poultry, livestock, and animal nutrition sectors.
Build and maintain strong relationships with poultry farms, livestock farms, distributors, dealers, and key customers.
Promote and sell poultry feed, livestock feed, and other animal nutrition products.
Conduct regular customer visits to understand requirements, market demand, and competitor activities.
Monitor market trends, competitor pricing, customer preferences, and industry developments.
Lead, supervise, and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and departmental targets.
Coordinate with production and supply chain teams to ensure product availability and timely customer deliveries.
Negotiate sales contracts, pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements within approved company policies.
Monitor customer accounts, outstanding payments, and coordinate with Finance for timely collections.
Prepare sales forecasts, budgets, performance reports, and market development plans.
Coordinate with the technical and nutrition teams to provide appropriate product recommendations and customer support.
Ensure customer satisfaction, resolve complaints, and maintain long-term business relationships.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Agriculture, Animal Science, or a related field.
MBA or relevant professional qualifications will be an advantage.
8–12 years of relevant sales experience, preferably in the animal feed, poultry feed, livestock feed, or animal nutrition industry.
Minimum 3–5 years in a sales leadership or managerial position.
Strong experience in B2B sales and managing key accounts.
Established network within the Saudi Arabian poultry and livestock industry will be an advantage.

d: We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Retail Leasing Specialist to join our Agency team in Bahrain. This role offers the opportunity to work with leading landlords, developers, and retail brands while building long-term client relationships and driving commercial results.

Savills is a leading global real estate company with a strong presence across the Middle East. The business provides a wide range of services across property management, valuation, consultancy, facilities management and commercial and residential real estate. In the Middle East, the team works across key markets including the UAE and Saudi Arabia, supporting major clients and a variety of high-profile assets. It’s a well-established business with a collaborative culture and good opportunities for career development.
q: Minimum 5 years' experience in retail leasing, ideally within shopping malls, retail destinations, or mixed-use developments.
Strong understanding of the Bahrain retail real estate market, together with awareness of regional retail trends and occupier requirements.
Proven track record of securing leasing transactions and achieving revenue and business development targets.
Experience advising and negotiating with landlords, retailers, developers, and other key stakeholders.
Strong understanding of commercial lease structures and lease terms.
Experience preparing and negotiating Heads of Terms and supporting lease documentation.
Proven success in new lettings, lease renewals, tenant retention, and leasing advisory.
Strong business development, networking, and client relationship management skills.
Experience preparing reports, presentations, and recommendations for clients and senior stakeholders.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines.
Strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
MRICS, AssocRICS, or working towards RICS accreditation.
Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related discipline.
Existing network of local, regional, and international retail brands, franchise operators, and F&B operators.
Experience working across the GCC retail market.
Knowledge of retail asset management, retail strategy, and development projects.
Experience using property databases, CRM platforms, and market research tools.
Previous real estate licensing or accreditation, such as RERA or equivalent GCC professional certification.

Over 42,000 people work for us in more than 700 offices all over the world. This breadth of global coverage, combined with specialist services and market insight, means we'll always have an expert who is local to you.
